steps.label: Day 5 — Early Win Capture

steps.body:
{{contact.first_name}},

It's Day 5. By now the system has been running long enough to show results.

What's your first win? Could be:
- First lead captured automatically
- First conversation handled by the AI
- First booking closed without you
- Time saved

And if nothing's moved yet — tell me. We fix it together today.

steps.label: Day 14 — Referral Ask
steps.subject: Who else needs this?
steps.body:
{{contact.first_name}},

Two weeks in. The system is running.

Quick ask: who's the one person in your network who needs exactly what you just got?

Send me their name + best contact method. I'll handle the outreach — and you get [REFERRAL INCENTIVE] when they come on board.

One name. Takes 10 seconds.

Reply here.

{{location.name}}
